blurb: With almost 43 acres of rolling Carroll County farmland at your fingertips, you’ll find all sorts of ways to engage with God and His creation. From the beautiful hiking trails to the tranquility and peace of the outdoor chapel, your kids will find many ways to “come away to a quiet place” with God.
